args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The tests in tests/test_money.py expect banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN) but round_money was using ROUND_HALF_UP,
causing the nightly build to fail (e.g. Decimal("2.665")
rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66).
- Fixed by switching the `quantize` rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` (sha 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
